answer: Bayesian truth serum grades answers. Each juror gives a grade and predicts the panel's grade histogram; pay comes from a proper scoring rule that rewards a verdict more common than predicted, an informative surprise. Honest readers send ivory-clear signal because independent calls beat the expected mix. A hollow ring of clones repeats one verdict and predicts that same echo, so no copy is surprisingly frequent and the farm earns near zero. To profit, each wallet must enter through the inlet of its own genuine belief, paying fresh analysis per identity, not replaying one script.
